items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 70:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the complete male power? The Mochin of the Nesira that the Nukva receives for the completion of her Partzuf in a stature equal to ZA, from his back, come from the Aba and Ima of the AB of the Mazal. From these Mochin, he gives her this spirit of the first union, which corrects her Yesod so that it will be fit to raise MAN for the GAR of the souls, as is known. And these Mochin are the aspect of Chaya and the stature of AB of Yodin, so that accordingly the Nukva should have received from them the stature of Chaya at the time that she was in the back of ZA. However, it is not so, for the drop of Chaya does not remain in her, because this stature of Chaya is “a complete male power”, meaning that it is a stature of Chaya belonging to ZA and not to the Nukva, since it came out upon the Mazal. It is the aspect of the male Gevurot, in which the Nukva has no root, for she is the aspect of the female Gevurot, meaning that she is the aspect of actual Malchut, and not the Yesod of Malchut, which is the aspect of the Nukva included in the male. But only in order to complete the building of her Partzuf, namely the lowering of the lower Hey from the eyes and the raising of the vessels of the AHP, she had to be included in the aspect of the Nukva within the body of ZA, so that she could receive, for her time, these Mochin of AB. And then she receives only the aspect of the AB of SAG, MAH, and BAN, which are the aspect of the 216 of this stature of AB, called the male Hassadim of the NRN within it, sufficient to raise the vessels of the AHP. But the AB itself, which is the stature of Chaya, she cannot receive at this time, for she must first complete the vessels of her Partzuf. And after she completed her vessels, she returns to the Aba and Ima of the face-to-face, and receives the Mochin of AB from the head of ZA, clothed in the NHY of ZA, which are from the Malchut of Ima that is not included in the Mazal, which are Mochin of the Nukva. And the aspect of the AB of Yodin of the Mazal, the root of the complete male power, only ZA alone receives, who is male, and the Nukva has no share in them. (Item 105).
